title: Who's on the Moon? The birthplaces of the people we named other worlds after
excerpt: I traced 2,718 names on the Moon, Mercury, Venus and Mars back to the towns where those people were born. 75% of the Moon's people were born in Europe, and Paris alone outnumbers Africa, South America and Oceania.
seo_description: Whose names are on the Moon? 75% of lunar namesakes were born in Europe. A map linking craters to birthplaces on Earth.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Who's on the Moon?' in black and red on parchment, beside a world map with coloured dots at the birthplaces of the people lunar craters are named after, densest in Europe, with the lines '75% of the Moon's people were born in Europe' and 'Paris: 38 lunar features. Africa, South America and Oceania together: 31.'
